standard_prerequisites.name: Henselization and strict henselization and their faithful flatness over the local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, label algebra-definition-henselization (statement, proof line 187); More on Algebra, label more-algebra-lemma-dumb-properties-henselization (proof line 210)
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the rings and gives that the local ring maps from the local ring to its henselization and to its strict henselization are faithfully flat, which yields the implications downwards by composition of flat maps.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition and descent of flatness along faithfully flat ring maps
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, labels algebra-lemma-composition-flat (proof line 216) and algebra-lemma-flatness-descends (proof line 219)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first gives the implications (3) implies (2) implies (1) and (5) implies (4), and the second gives the equivalences relating the statements about a module over the local ring or over the henselization to the statement over the strict henselization.

standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness up and down along an etale neighbourhood, the colimit descriptions of the henselizations, and flatness of a colimit
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter flat.tex, label lemma-etale-flat-up-down-local-ring (proof line 227); Algebra, labels algebra-lemma-henselization-different and algebra-lemma-strict-henselization-different (proof lines 232-233) and algebra-lemma-colimit-rings-flat (proof line 236)
standard_prerequisites.use: Together they show that flatness over the local ring persists to every etale neighbourhood and hence, because the henselizations are directed colimits of those local rings, to the henselization and the strict henselization, which proves the remaining implication.

core_obligations: Collect the easy implications: the local ring maps to the henselization and to the strict henselization are faithfully flat, so flatness over the strict henselization descends to the henselization and to the local ring, and the same holds for the corresponding statements about a module defined over the henselization; faithful flatness also gives the equivalences relating the cases (6), (5) and (3). It remains to prove that flatness over the local ring implies flatness over the henselization and the strict henselization, and that flatness over the henselization implies it over the strict henselization (proof lines 208-223).

Reduce to the colimit computation: by the up and down lemma for an etale neighbourhood, flatness over the local ring implies flatness over the local ring of every etale neighbourhood of the point; since the henselization and the strict henselization are directed colimits of such local rings, flatness passes to the colimits by the corresponding flatness criterion (proof lines 225-236).

Conclude the remaining case and finish: the argument for the henselization replaced by the local ring gives the implication from flatness over the henselization to flatness over the strict henselization, and combining all the implications with the descent equivalences proves the list of equivalent conditions (proof lines 237-240).
proof_roadmap: Faithful flatness gives the downward implications and the descent equivalences (proof lines 208-223).
The up and down lemma plus the colimit description of the henselizations proves the upward implication (proof lines 225-236).
Replace the local ring by the henselization to finish (proof lines 237-240).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that flatness of a module over a local ring, over its henselization and over its strict henselization are equivalent conditions, with the expected variants when the module is pulled back from the local ring or from the henselization (statement lines 182-206, tag 05VL). Faithful flatness handles the downward implications and the descent equivalences, but the upward implication needs the up and down lemma for an etale neighbourhood together with the fact that the henselizations are directed colimits of the local rings of those neighbourhoods, plus the flatness criterion for a colimit. That colimit step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
